HSV three-tier · 64 / 32 / 16

64 hues at 5.625° intervals. Each receives a 3×3 bright, saturated core; every second hue gains nine middle-band samples, and every fourth hue gains nine outer-band samples. Sixteen evenly spaced HSV grays complete the palette.

All formats (ZIP)Hex textGIMPKritaColor auditExact sample coordinates

576 + 288 + 144 + 16 = 1,024 colors

Each graph uses the whole 0–100% saturation/value square at the same scale. Bright regions are the sampled areas; numbered circles are the actual sample locations. In the main version, each added band contains three nested Ls, sampled at both ends and the bend. The previous boundary is not repeated. The comparison version uses the 10% lattice.

Grayscale is V = 0/15 through 15/15, producing RGB levels 0, 17, …, 255, in both versions. The 10% grid restriction applies to the colored samples. Perceptual distance is measured for comparison; both profiles keep their HSV geometry without ΔE pruning.

All 1,024 colors

Display order is lightness bands with alternating hue order. Each color appears once.
